column3: “Cause to pass away” is rendered “remove,” and “the spirit of uncleanness” “the unclean spirit.”
“Begot” is rendered “gave birth to”; NASB adds “if” and “then.”
“A cloak of hair” is rendered “a hairy robe.”
“Someone sold me” is rendered “a man sold me as a slave,” supplying “as a slave”; the Hebrew is difficult and the meaning is uncertain.
“Between your hands” is rendered “between your arms,” and “the house of my friends” “in the house of my friends.”
“Shepherd” is capitalized “My Shepherd,” and “the man of my community” “the man, My Associate”; “on” is rendered “against.”
“A mouth of two” is rendered “two parts”; NASB adds “But.”
“In the fire” is rendered “through the fire”; “it” is rendered “They,” and “I will answer it” “I will answer them.”
